text:
maria: Heads up — CI failing on audit-validator smoke for a customer-facing event. Failure is an assertion on the 'namespace' field: expected string matching /^org:\/[^/]+$/ but got null. reproducer below.
kevin: Can you paste the failing event and the schema snippet?
maria: Sure — event snippet:
```json
{
  "actor": "svc-redwood",
  "action": "deployment.update",
  "resource": {
    "id": "deploy-123",
    "type": "deployment",
    "namespace": null
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T18:22:10Z"
}
```
schema excerpt: `properties.resource.properties.namespace: { type: ["string"], pattern: '^org:/[^/]+' }` — looks like a semantics change from when namespace could be omitted for system-level events.
rachel: This started after the RBAC change that introduced multi-namespace principals last week. I think kube-style namespace can be empty for org-scoped resources now.
kevin: CI failure stack: `audit-validator --goldenset /goldens/latest validate event.json` -> `AssertionError: namespace does not match pattern` — golden fixtures also failing.
audit-bot: Golden fixture mismatch detected: 3 events (namespace field) — run id 2026-03-19-21:01
sam: Is this a schema tightening or a regression? If it's tightening we need a migration plan; if regression we revert.
maria: I dug into commit b2c9f — schema was tightened to require `namespace` for all resources. Change rationale was to make downstream indexing consistent. But downstream indexers treat `null` as global org scope.
kevin: Reproducer: run `pytest tests/security/test_audit_fixtures.py::test_namespace_patterns -k runners/ubuntu-22` — fails on the linux runner only (race?), might be CI env differences.
rachel: Customer impact? Any customer reported incorrect events?
sam: Ops ticket: CS-5142 — customer reported missing namespace on some audit lines last week. Could be same root.
kevin: Proposed triage steps: 1) revert strict pattern in schema to allow null OR string matching pattern 2) add explicit `scope` enum to differentiate org vs namespace 3) get a quick patch into `main` and run golden set CI.
maria: I'll open PR for fallback change: allow `null` and add a deprecation note for indexers. Patch branch `fix/audit-namespace-null-allow`.
devops-oncall: If we patch, should we push to Dedicated and Private first before Hosted? Hosted has higher throughput; better to canary to dedicated region eu-west-1.
sam: Agree. Also add a CI gate to run golden fixtures in serial (flaky parallel runs hide ordering problems).
kevin: I ran local fix — tests pass. Need someone to merge and trigger golden regen then notify customers.
rachel: I'll take customer comms if we need to explain changed behavior. For now flag as P1 internal until we confirm regression window.
maria: Thanks — PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/redwood/audit-validator/pull/482 — includes tests and a note to ops for canary rollout. @kevin can you review?
kevin: On it. :eyes:

(note: thread created from CI alert, timestamp references are root message times.)
